dct_description_sm:
An element of the drainage system intended for the collection and delivery of runoff water to the sewer line or ditch. Structure, equipped with a spillway, used to capture runoff and deliver it, as appropriate, to the storm sewer or combined sewer line. The information associated with the geographic data corresponds to the type of sump, date of installation, status, owner, and jurisdiction.

__CAUTION__: This data is published annually, so it does not include updates made during the year. For this reason, they should under no circumstances be used for engineering purposes without validation by the City.
